verses.text: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
lines: Every wise woman builds her house,
but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

verses.text: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
lines: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh,
but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

verses.text: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
lines: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back,
but the lips of the wise protect them.

verses.text: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
lines: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean,
but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

verses.text: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
lines: A truthful witness will not lie,
but a false witness pours out lies.

verses.text: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
lines: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it,
but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

verses.text: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
lines: Stay away from a foolish man,
for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

verses.text: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
lines: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way,
but the folly of fools is deceit.

verses.text: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
lines: Fools mock at making atonement for sins,
but among the upright there is good will.

verses.text: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
lines: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy;
he will not share these with a stranger.

verses.text: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
lines: The house of the wicked will be overthrown,
but the tent of the upright will flourish.

verses.text: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
lines: There is a way which seems right to a man,
but in the end it leads to death.

verses.text: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
lines: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful,
and mirth may end in heaviness.

verses.text: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
lines: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways;
likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

verses.text: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
lines: A simple man believes everything,
but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

verses.text: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
lines: A wise man fears and shuns evil,
but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

verses.text: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
lines: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly,
and a crafty man is hated.

verses.text: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
lines: The simple inherit folly,
but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

verses.text: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
lines: The evil bow down before the good,
and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

verses.text: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
lines: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor,
but the rich person has many friends.

verses.text: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.
lines: He who despises his neighbor sins,
but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

verses.text: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
lines: Don’t they go astray who plot evil?
But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

verses.text: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
lines: In all hard work there is profit,
but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

verses.text: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
lines: The crown of the wise is their riches,
but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

verses.text: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
lines: A truthful witness saves souls,
but a false witness is deceitful.

verses.text: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
lines: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress,
and he will be a refuge for his children.

verses.text: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
lines: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life,
turning people from the snares of death.

verses.text: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
lines: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory,
but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

verses.text: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
lines: He who is slow to anger has great understanding,
but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

verses.text: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
lines: The life of the body is a heart at peace,
but envy rots the bones.

verses.text: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
lines: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker,
but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

verses.text: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
lines: The wicked is brought down in his calamity,
but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

verses.text: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
lines: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding,
and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

verses.text: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
lines: Righteousness exalts a nation,
but sin is a disgrace to any people.

verses.text: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
lines: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely,
but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
